title: Earliest track: demo-email-notifications-v2 reaches full Production
notes: Adds prod-eu-west-01 at forty per cent of population, the largest cluster and the last one. demo-email-notifications-v2 now serves true to all Production traffic, completing the accelerating curve of 5, 15, 30, 60, 100.

Applied at the start of the business-hours window so the final and largest step is sampled at hundred-context batches for roughly eleven hours rather than at forty overnight. This is the step where timing matters most.
Rules still, not a fallthrough change. The terminal state comes next: clearing the rules and serving true, which is the last targeting change before the seven-day stability window begins.
demo-tax-calculation-v2 remains restated at thirty per cent. It has no evaluator under the current connection budget, and advancing an unobserved flag would spend schedule without buying evidence.
